plain.li: [day:greet] Hello, {PET_nameDef}, I'm back.
[day:greet] Easy, {PET_nameDef}, I'm home now.
[day:greet] Did you miss me, {PET_nameDef}?
[day:greet] Good to see you too, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:greet,family:canine] Down, {PET_nameDef}, you'll knock me over.
[day:greet,family:feline] So you did notice I was gone, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:greet,body:bird] Hello, {PET_nameDef}, I've no food on me, sorry.
[day:greet,young] You've grown while I was away, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:greet,pokemon] Good to see you, {PET_nameDef}, were you all right while I was gone?
[day:foot] Last night {PET_nameDef} slept at the foot of my bed.
[day:foot] I heard {PET_nameDef} come in last night and lie down by the bed.
[day:foot] Good morning, {PET_nameDef}, you slept in here again.
[day:foot,family:canine] You stayed by my bed all night, {PET_nameDef}, good dog.
[day:foot,young] Last night {PET_nameDef} came in and curled up by my bed.
[day:foot,temper:lazy] Time to get up, {PET_nameDef}, you've slept long enough.
[day:beg] No, {PET_nameDef}, this is my food.
[day:beg] You've had yours, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:beg] Stop staring at my plate, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:beg] All right, one bite, {PET_nameDef}, and that's all.
[day:beg,temper:greedy] You only just ate, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:beg,family:canine] Sit, {PET_nameDef}, you're not getting any.
[day:beg,family:feline] Keep your paws off the table, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:beg,body:bird] Stop pecking at my bowl, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:beg,mine] I know you're hungry, {PET_nameDef}, but this is mine.
[day:play] Come back, {PET_nameDef}, it's my turn to chase you!
[day:play] Wait for me, {PET_nameDef}!
[day:play] You can't catch me, {PET_nameDef}!
[day:play] Run, {PET_nameDef}, I'm coming!
[day:play,body:bird] Come back, {PET_nameDef}, I just want to hold you.
[day:play,family:canine] Fetch, {PET_nameDef}, over here!
[day:play,family:feline] Where did you go, {PET_nameDef}?
[day:play,temper:lazy] Don't lie down yet, {PET_nameDef}, we're still playing.
[day:herd] The herd is following {PET_nameDef} out to graze.
[day:herd] There goes {PET_nameDef}, with the rest behind.
[day:herd] Looks like {PET_nameDef} is taking them to fresh grass.
[day:herd,body:bird] The whole flock is following {PET_nameDef}.
[day:herd,oldanimal] Even at its age, {PET_nameDef} still leads them out.
[day:rounds] Morning, {PET_nameDef}, let's have a look at you.
[day:rounds] Hold still, {PET_nameDef}, this won't take long.
[day:rounds] You look well, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:rounds,sick] Let me see you, {PET_nameDef}, you don't look well.
[day:rounds,hurt] Easy, {PET_nameDef}, let me see where you're hurt.
[day:rounds,pregnant] Not long to go now, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:rounds,young] You're getting big, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:rounds,oldanimal] Stiff this morning, {PET_nameDef}?
[day:rounds,herdmaster] Time to check on all of you, starting with {PET_nameDef}.
[day:shelter,rain] Look, {PET_nameDef} has come in out of the rain.
[day:shelter,rain] Come inside, {PET_nameDef}, you're getting soaked.
[day:shelter,snow] Look, {PET_nameDef} has come in out of the snow.
[day:shelter,snow] Come in, {PET_nameDef}, you're covered in snow.
[day:shelter,family:canine] Don't shake yourself off in here, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:shelter,family:feline] Come in, {PET_nameDef}, I know you hate getting wet.
[day:snow] I don't think {PET_nameDef} has seen snow before.
[day:snow] Look at {PET_nameDef} jumping about in the snow.
[day:snow] It's only snow, {PET_nameDef}.
[day:huddle] The herd is lying close together against the cold.
[day:huddle] They're all lying around {PET_nameDef} to keep warm.
[day:huddle] It's a cold night, so the animals are huddled up.
[day:alarm] Look, {PET_nameDef} has seen something {PLACE}.
[day:alarm] Something's coming {PLACE}, look at {PET_nameDef}.
[day:alarm] Good, {PET_nameDef}, I see them too.
[day:alarm,family:canine] Listen, {PET_nameDef} is barking at someone {PLACE}.
[day:alarm,family:feline] Look, {PET_nameDef} is staring at something {PLACE}.
[day:alarm,body:bird] Listen to {PET_nameDef}, there's someone {PLACE}.

[day:uneasy] Easy, {PET_nameDef}, there's nothing there.
[day:uneasy] Today {PET_nameDef} won't leave my side.
[day:uneasy] What's got into {PET_nameDef} today?

[day:uneasy,family:feline] Look, {PET_nameDef}'s fur is standing on end.

[day:mourn] I think {PET_nameDef} knows {OTHER_nameDef} is dead.
[day:mourn] Leave {PET_nameDef} be, it wants to stay with {OTHER_nameDef}.
[day:mourn] Poor {PET_nameDef}, it was always with {OTHER_nameDef}.

[day:beg] Here, {PET_nameDef}, you can have the crust.
[day:rounds] There you are, {PET_nameDef}, let's see how you're doing.
[day:shelter] Come and dry off next to me, {PET_nameDef}.

[day:beg] Everyone wants something from my plate.
[day:uneasy] I don't like it when the animals act like this.
